'''2005 Coruscant Regional''' was a Star Wars CCG regional and qualifier for the [[2005 World Championship]], played on 11 December 2004 at Mystic Visions 4.12 in Columbia, Pennsylvania. It offered two byes into Day 2 of the World Championship, the chance for the winner to design a [[Virtual cards|Virtual Card]], and a guaranteed $100 cash prize for first place.<ref name="pcf-4120-56482">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=56482#56482 Mystic Visions 4.12 - December 11, 2004 - 27 Hours of Gaming], Mike Carr, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (17 November 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050107081925/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58042%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> [[Greg Shaw]] won with a 6–0 record; [[Kevin Elia]] was second and [[Jarad Konsker]] third.<ref name="pcf-4120-58215">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58215#58215 Mystic Visions 4.12 - December 11, 2004 - 27 Hours of Gaming], Bill Kafer, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (11 December 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050107081925/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58042%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The Day 2 byes went to Shaw and Elia.<ref name="pc-events05">[http://swccgpc.com/events.htm 2004/2005 Events: SWCCG 2005 Worlds Qualifiers Listing], swccgpc.com (updated 27 June 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050828001521/http://swccgpc.com:80/events.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS8]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Vigilant Fire Company #2, 265 South 10th Street, Columbia, Pennsylvania (Mystic Visions 4.12)<ref name="pcf-4120-56482" />
* '''Dates:''' 11 December 2004<ref name="pcf-4120-56482" /><ref name="pcf-4120-58215" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Michael Carr|Mike Carr]], Players Committee [[Tournament Advocate]]<ref name="pcf-4120-56482" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10 and 5 cans of food, on top of the convention's entry fee of 20 cans of food<ref name="pcf-4120-56482" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Greg Shaw]]<ref name="pcf-4120-58215" />
* '''Day 2 byes:''' [[Greg Shaw]], [[Kevin Elia]]<ref name="pc-events05" />

== Mystic Visions 4.12 ==

Mystic Visions was a charity gaming convention in central Pennsylvania, held twice a year, that raised money for the Columbia Consolidated Fire Company and food for the local community. Mystic Visions 4.12 ran from 9 am on 11 December to 12 pm on 12 December 2004, with tournaments for many games and sanctioned "instantournaments" for all Decipher games. The cans of food went into gift baskets for local families in need and to the local food bank.<ref name="pcf-4120-56482" /> The convention held over the summer of 2004 ([[2004 Mystic Visions]]) had drawn 25 Star Wars CCG players.<ref name="pcf-4120-56482" />

== Prizes ==

Besides the guaranteed $100 for first place, tournament foils, uncut sheets and booster packs were given out. Further cash prizes depended on attendance: for each of the 11th to 15th players, $10 went to second place ($50 at most); for each of the next three, $10 went to third place ($30 at most); for each of the next two, $10 went to the highest-finishing youngest player outside the top three ($20 at most); and each player above 20 added $5 to the first prize and $5 donated in the winner's name to the Columbia Consolidated Fire Company.<ref name="pcf-4120-56482" />
